module: Flowgraph node "im Dialogue" (category repeat_instant, singleActive, tag imgui): imgui window with title, description and buttons. Inputs: "title", "description"; for each option (editable list, default accept / decline) a string input pin (label) and a flow output pin set to true on click. Word wrap width: data.wrapSize (500).
notes: Bug: work() calls self:closeDialogue() and self:closed(), which are not defined in this file (error on first click if the base class does not provide them).
Showing two of these at the same time will break everything (todo from the code).
updateButtons: all output links are put in flowLinks, and strLinks stays empty (input links are not recreated correctly).

work.desc: If open, draws the window, the text and the buttons.
